title: Ammaron instructs young Mormon
summary: Ammaron comes to Mormon when Mormon is about ten years old and instructs him to remember his observations and, at about twenty-four, go to hill Shim in the land Antum, take the plates of Nephi, leave the remaining records, and engrave what he has observed.

explicit_facts.text: Ammaron came to Mormon when Mormon was about ten years old; Mormon had begun to learn after the manner of his people.
Ammaron described Mormon as sober and quick to observe.
Ammaron instructed Mormon to remember what he had observed and, when about twenty-four, go to hill Shim in the land Antum.
Ammaron said he had deposited sacred engravings there and instructed Mormon to take the plates of Nephi, leave the remainder in place, and engrave his observations on the plates of Nephi.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Ammaron and young Mormon are together during the conversation.
unspecified_visual_details: Their appearance, the exact setting, and whether any records are visible during the conversation.
